name: 陽明
edge_source_summary: Yang Ming's August 2026 H1 results directly tie Q2 earnings improvement to Asia-Europe and Transpacific booking demand and higher freight-rate levels, and describe cargo demand, fleet deployment and capacity as key Q3 operating variables. This establishes direct current economic exposure to the container-freight cycle.
edge_counter_evidence: Yang Ming also cites global fleet-capacity growth exceeding container-demand growth and geopolitical/tariff uncertainty, so stronger spot rates may not persist uniformly across routes.

name: 裕民
edge_source_summary: U-Ming is directly exposed through Capesize, Panamax, Post-Panamax and Ultramax dry-bulk vessels. At its 2026 AGM the company said dry-bulk fundamentals were improving, Capesize rates were leading, tonne-mile demand from Simandou/Guinea exports was rising and effective supply remained constrained; it also continued expanding its dry-bulk fleet. This is a direct current economic edge to the dry-bulk freight cycle.
edge_counter_evidence: Nominal fleet supply growth and macro/trade-policy weakness remain counter-risks, and U-Ming is diversifying into LNG and other shipping segments, reducing pure-play exposure.

name: 慧洋-KY
edge_source_summary: Wisdom Marine identifies itself as a dry-bulk shipping company with a large diversified bulk fleet and predominantly charter-hire revenue. Its September 3 monthly earnings release showed year-to-date revenue +33.66%, operating profit +206.12% and month-end BDI 3,186, providing current company-level evidence of economic sensitivity to the dry-bulk freight environment.
edge_counter_evidence: A large share of the fleet is on time charter, which can damp or delay spot-rate transmission; dry-dock schedules and JPY-linked financing also affect earnings independently of freight rates.

name: 新興
edge_source_summary: Sincere Navigation identifies dry-bulk shipping as its principal business and its current fleet includes four Kamsarmax bulkers, seven Capesize bulkers and one 250,000-DWT ore carrier, establishing direct economic exposure to dry-bulk freight rates and tonne-mile demand.
edge_counter_evidence: The fleet also includes three VLCC crude tankers, so company earnings are not a pure dry-bulk proxy and can diverge from BDI/BCI when tanker economics move differently.

name: 台航
edge_source_summary: Taiwan Navigation identifies dry-bulk shipping as its core business and reports 21 dry-bulk vessels in its fleet; July 2026 operating commentary also states that spot-linked vessel day rates rose with the dry-bulk market, directly demonstrating current transmission from freight conditions into operating economics.
edge_counter_evidence: Part of the fleet is protected by long-term contracts and the company also operates passenger/cargo ferry, harbor and special-vessel businesses, which dampens one-for-one sensitivity to spot dry-bulk indices.

edge_counter_evidence: High memory prices can weaken consumer demand; inventory gains and channel pricing can reverse if the supply-demand gap closes faster than expected.

name: 長榮
edge_source_summary: Evergreen Marine is primarily a global container-shipping operator; its 2025 reporting shows freight revenue represented about 93% of operating revenue, while Taiwan's Maritime and Port Bureau lists Evergreen among national carriers filing route freight rates. This establishes direct economic sensitivity to the container-freight cycle.
edge_counter_evidence: Evergreen's scale, contract mix, bunker costs and fleet deployment can cause realized revenue and margins to diverge from spot indices; management has also flagged weaker demand/inflation risks beyond the peak season.

name: 萬海
edge_source_summary: Wan Hai identifies itself as a marine container-shipping company whose business depends on container transport demand, route deployment and freight-rate conditions; its current tariff/bunker notices show direct commercial pricing exposure on major trades. This is a direct operating edge to the container-freight cycle.
edge_counter_evidence: Fuel surcharges, vessel additions and route mix can change realized economics independently of headline spot freight indices; strong spot rates do not map one-for-one into earnings.

name: 緯穎
edge_source_summary: Wiwynn is a hyperscale data-center and cloud-infrastructure ODM. Its 2026 Q1 disclosure says server rack sales increased month over month and full-year shipment volume was still expected to grow at a double-digit rate; its 2026 annual report states its products had shipped to more than 750 hyperscale data centers and that it held nearly 30% of global ODM-Direct server shipments in 2025. This is direct current economic exposure to the AI-server shipment cycle.
edge_counter_evidence: Customer concentration and procurement-model changes can distort reported revenue versus physical shipment volume; strong AI demand therefore does not map one-for-one into revenue growth.
